name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.bitLoop_spec
typeText:
∀ (m₀ : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem) (bs : List.{0} Bool) (q1 c : Nat) (m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem),
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.BitInv m₀ bs q1 c 0 m →
    ∃ m' k,
      And (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cmd.Exec DisequalityDispersion.Machine.bitLoop m m' k)
        (And (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.BitInv m₀ bs q1 c c m')
          (LE.le.{0} k (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} c 11) 2)))

source.code:
theorem bitLoop_spec (m₀ : Mem) (bs : List Bool) (q1 c : ℕ) (m : Mem)
    (hI : BitInv m₀ bs q1 c 0 m) :
    ∃ m' k, Cmd.Exec bitLoop m m' k ∧ BitInv m₀ bs q1 c c m' ∧ k ≤ c * 11 + 2 := by
  have := forLoop_spec J CNT bitBody (BitInv m₀ bs q1 c) c 8
    (fun j m hI => ⟨hI.jv, hI.cnt⟩)
    (fun j m hj hI => by
      obtain ⟨m', k, e, hk, hJ, hone, hI'⟩ := bitBody_spec m₀ bs q1 c j m hI hj
      exact ⟨m', k, e, hk, hJ, hone, hI'⟩)
    0 m (by omega) hI
  obtain ⟨m', k, e, hI', hk⟩ := this
  exact ⟨m', k, e, hI', by simpa using hk⟩
